c.f39360e826: Two players closer than this (meters) count as the same group. The helicopter is sent to the BIGGEST group of players, not to the first one connected. All players isolated: one of them is picked at random. Default 500.
c.51f638c2e8: Where the helicopter spawns and patrols, relative to the reference player.
c.c5ac7f6770: Last resort only: if no POI is found (see PoiSearchRadiusMeters), the spawn anchor is a random point between MinSpawnDistanceMeters and this radius (meters) around the player. Default 1500.
c.84b4999294: Radius (meters) around the player in which a POI of PoiHierarchy is searched as spawn anchor; if none is found, the search is retried at twice this radius. Default 600.
c.62948b5f6a: Radius (meters) of the patrol loop around the spawn point. Nearby POIs are used as patrol points first, random points fill the rest. Default 1000.
c.b05113ab44: Number of points in the helicopter patrol loop. Default 5.
c.06bbc27306: Exact spawn point around the anchor POI.
c.c460cacfb3: Minimum horizontal distance (meters) from the anchor POI (also the inner radius of the last-resort area). Default 300.
c.1431f5b08e: Maximum horizontal distance (meters) from the anchor POI. Must be > MinSpawnDistanceMeters. Default 600.
c.966d8d527a: Minimum spawn height (meters) above the ground of the anchor POI. Default 200.
c.78dd48d123: Maximum spawn height (meters) above the ground of the anchor POI. Default 350.
c.d63a6acf8f: Skill of the pilot and crew: Noob, Rookie, Regular, Veteran or Expert (case-sensitive). Unknown value = Regular with a warning. Default Expert.
c.433feb5bf9: Seconds between starting the engine and handing the helicopter to the scripted flight. Without it the airframe moves while the rotor is still spinning up. Default 5.
c.082104c4c7: How long to wait for the pilot group to be fully spawned before aborting the helicopter spawn. Raise it if the engine AI spawn queue is busy (many garrisons spawning). Default 30.
c.39d7f1b0a4: How long to wait for the pilot to be seated in the helicopter before giving up on the crew and patrol setup. Default 30.
c.21f0a1d4d5: What happens once the helicopter is shot down, loses its pilot or a rotor, or lands.
c.a2bec4c4cd: Safety net: this many seconds after the pilot dies, a rotor is destroyed or the helicopter is destroyed, it is forced into a wreck and the cleanup starts. Default 10.
c.d8d172f8ae: Time (seconds) the wreck stays in the world before it is deleted together with its pilot and crew groups. Default 180.
c.413f684cbf: NO EFFECT: not used by the current code (the wreck is deleted after WreckageLifetimeSeconds wherever the players are).
c.db09d6107d: NO EFFECT: not used by the current code (the wreck is deleted even if a player is looking at it).
c.a83865fcbf: Extra wait (seconds) after the wreck is deleted before a new helicopter may spawn. Delay from destruction to the next helicopter = WreckageLifetimeSeconds + this value (180 + 1200 = 23 min). Lower it for tests. Default 1200.
c.8ed91e802e: Height above ground (meters) under which the helicopter counts as landed. A landed helicopter, or one in water, destroys itself. Default 3.0.
c.08343e15be: Speed (m/s) under which the helicopter counts as landed (together with GroundedAltitudeMeters). Default 1.5.
c.d7e2ada706: The landed condition must hold this long (seconds) before the self-destruction. Water triggers it at once. Default 2.
c.a116a023bf: If the scripted destruction fails, the helicopter is deleted after this delay (seconds). Default 30.
c.d4f7c5655d: Custom flight controller (not the Bohemia AI flight). Values interact: change one at a time and test. WARNING: when a key is missing the code default is used, and several defaults are very different from the tuned values below.
c.bf3f58d31e: Horizontal distance (meters) at which a patrol point counts as reached. Default 75.0.
c.9611edd5ec: Maximum turn and roll rate (radians per second). Higher = sharper turns. Default 0.5.
c.7453207c0a: Maximum vertical speed (m/s), up or down. Default 5.0.
c.754a455999: How strongly an altitude error is corrected (vertical m/s per meter of error). Too high = the helicopter bounces up and down. Default 0.3.
c.82e60c3374: Constant upward speed (m/s) added against residual sinking. Default 1.5.
c.1f23741ff5: Flight height (meters) above the ground height of each patrol point. Default 150.0.
c.e68f64e91d: How often (seconds) the controller recomputes its target; the motion itself is applied at 60 Hz and smoothed in between. Default 0.1.
c.178493dbca: Tilt in turns: turns the turn rate into a bank angle (capped). Higher = more tilt. Default 2.0.
c.3f27012fe1: Order in which POI categories are tried as spawn anchor; the closest POI of the first category that has one wins. Allowed values: Military (military bases, airports, radio towers, spawn points), City (towns, settlements), Village (villages, hamlets, local places). Empty = random point around the player.
c.fc3a08de52: Helicopter types; one is picked at random by SpawnWeight. Only Faction USSR entries are used. Fields: Name = label shown in the logs; Prefab = helicopter prefab, it must carry the INDF_CombatHeliFlightController component; Faction = USSR; PilotGroupPrefab = AI group put in the pilot seat; CrewGroupPrefab = AI group put in the turrets; SpawnWeight = relative chance (20 vs 40 = half as likely, 0 or less counts as 1).
c.06b45217da: NO EFFECT: this whole section is read but not used by the current code. Reserved for a future version.
c.d0c974e9d8: AI garrisons on the map points of interest (POI): each eligible POI gets a GUARD squad and a PATROL squad; small guard posts are also placed next to some vanilla buildings. A wiped POI squad is replaced after a cooldown. The engine limits active AI (128 by default): extra AI wait until there is room.
c.03edd3ce5a: true = module active, false = no garrison and no building post. Default false.
c.472814a218: Maximum number of POI garrisons created at startup (each = 2 squads), filled in the order of EligiblePoiTypes. Default 40.
c.e465cf4aa6: Garrisons and building posts are created in batches at startup so their AI spawn requests do not flood the engine queue: this many instances per batch. 0 = all at once. Default 4.
c.e2f409a717: Active-AI slots the garrisons and counter-attacks leave free under the engine cap (AIActiveLimit or the engine default 128), for the helicopter crew and other spawners. A garrison squad waits and a counter-attack wave is dropped while the reserve is reached. Must cover the helicopter crew (4 at most while it boards) plus one garrison squad. 0 = no reserve. Default 12.
c.f0b841f658: Seconds between two startup population batches. Default 5.
c.48ea3a8ffc: POI types that get a garrison, in priority order (the order matters once MaxGarrisonInstances is reached). Allowed: TOWN, SETTLEMENT, VILLAGE, HAMLET, LOCAL, MILITARY_BASE, AIRPORT, PORT, RADIO_TOWER, SPAWNPOINT, CONSTRUCTION_SITE, FUEL_STATION, HOSPITAL, FIRE_DEPARTMENT, POLICE_STATION, STORE, HOTEL, PUB, HILL, VALLEY, RIDGE, ISLAND, WATER_MAJOR, WATER_MINOR, LANDMARK, CAVE, CHURCH, TOWER. An unknown value is skipped with a warning. POIs under water or near a Conflict military base are always skipped.
c.a828a9711b: Placement and orders shared by all garrison squads.
c.5a38384f74: true = the GUARD squad may move on its own up to MaxAutonomousDistanceMeters from the POI. Default true.
c.945b31919e: How far (meters) the GUARD squad may wander from its defend point (only with AllowLocalPatrol). Default 80.0.
c.955393f0fd: Without a 'garrisonspawn' marker, a squad spawns at a random dry-land point between this and FallbackPlacementMaxRadiusMeters (meters) from the POI. Default 5.0.
c.e14ce3af4d: See FallbackPlacementMinRadiusMeters. Must be > the min value. Default 25.0.
c.e3334402be: Search radius (meters) around the POI for a hand-placed entity whose name contains 'garrisonspawn' (exact GUARD spawn point) and for a reaction trigger. Default 50.0.
c.2d120cc1fd: Defend waypoint given to GUARD squads. Expected: {93291E72AC23930F}Prefabs/AI/Waypoints/AIWaypoint_Defend.et. Another GUID loads another prefab even with the same path (e.g. {A70634B518C5C3B8} is AIWaypoint_Defend_Small). Empty = guards get no order.
c.637895c1d3: Move waypoint used by reinforcements to walk to the POI. Empty = no move order (only MaxInboundTravelSeconds applies).
c.8321f3eab6: No garrison and no building post within this radius (meters) of a Conflict military base (HQ or control point). Default 100.0.
c.b8cb481dd7: Terrain height (meters, sea level = 0) under which a point counts as water: POIs, posts and spawn points below it are skipped. Rivers and lakes above sea level are not detected. Default 0.5.
c.facc03888b: Radius (meters) of an INDF_MilitaryGarrisonReactionTrigger hand-placed near a POI in the World Editor (none = no effect). It only sets an internal 'recently engaged' flag that no behavior uses yet. Default 150.0.
c.8ca5a68776: One-shot AI counter-attack wave against a base the played faction just captured. Wiped garrisons and building posts are never replaced (PvE round: what players clean up stays clean until the round ends).
c.26126ccace: true = a captured base gets a counter-attack wave. Default true.
c.d30ef6bb7a: Minimum random delay (seconds) after the capture before the wave spawns. Default 60.
c.52e6c8219a: Maximum random delay (seconds) after the capture before the wave spawns. Default 180.
c.e6817d42c6: The wave spawns about this far (meters, +/- 10%) from the captured base on dry land, then walks to it. Default 600.0.
c.461705d5ff: The wave counts as arrived within this distance (meters) of the base. Default 25.0.
c.49bdbb9197: Safety net: after this time (seconds) the wave is resolved even if it has not arrived. Default 300.
c.604a70f9a2: Maximum number of counter-attack waves in flight at once; a capture beyond this cap is ignored (not queued). Default 2.
c.6e72c0e8ca: Loop walked by the PATROL squad of each POI.
c.e265266fbe: Radius (meters) around the POI in which the patrol points are drawn. Default 150.0.
c.ed9d41bb7b: Radius of the CLOSE patrol squad, as a fraction of PatrolRadiusMeters (0.5 = half). Each POI has two patrolling squads: the close one (marker spawn point, HIGH admission priority) and the wide one. Keep it well under 1.0 so the two loops do not overlap. Default 0.5.
c.2d00fbce5a: Number of points in the patrol loop. Points in water are dropped; fewer than 2 left = no patrol, the squad holds position. Default 5.
c.f7d40dfa96: Height tolerance (meters) for a patrol point to count as reached. Too low = squads can get stuck on slopes. Default 12.0.
c.f7ed72f69a: Cycle waypoint that loops the patrol points. Empty = no patrol loop, the squad holds position.
c.c179af50c3: Waypoint used for each patrol point. Default AIWaypoint_Patrol.
c.325fa03fd0: Safety net: if the members of a new squad are not all spawned after this delay (seconds), the guard or patrol order is given anyway. Default 30.
c.f04def6cde: AI groups used by PATROL squads; one is picked at random by SpawnWeight. Empty list = patrols use the Garrisons group. Fields: Faction = label only; UnitGroupPrefab = group prefab, its unit slots set the headcount (Team_AT 4, RifleSquad 6, FireGroup 4, Team_LAT 4); SpawnWeight = relative chance (0 or less counts as 1).
c.f69c8d838b: Small guard posts next to some vanilla buildings, in addition to the POI garrisons. Never replaced after a wipe.
c.dee4e21a68: true = building posts active. Default false.
c.bef455664e: Maximum number of building posts on the whole map, placed in scan order. Default 20.
c.7525d4ade0: Two posts are never closer than this (meters). Default 60.0.
c.cb9a2ef67c: No post closer than this (meters) to a POI garrison. Default 100.0.
c.f3eccb3c6f: Building types that can host a post. Fields: Name = label shown in the logs; PrefabPathContains = text searched (case-insensitive) in the building prefab path, e.g. GuardTower_01; Faction = label only; UnitGroupPrefab = group placed there, its unit slots set the headcount (SentryTeam 2, MachineGunTeam 2, FireGroup 4); SpawnChance = chance from 0.0 to 1.0 that a matching building gets a post (default 1.0); PlacementMinRadiusMeters / PlacementMaxRadiusMeters = random dry-land spawn ring around the building, in meters (default 3.0 / 8.0).
c.2843cdb255: AI groups used by the GUARD squad of every POI (and by PATROL squads when PatrolGroups is empty); one Faction USSR entry is picked at random by SpawnWeight. Fields: Faction = USSR; UnitGroupPrefab = group prefab, its unit slots set the headcount (SearchGroup = 11); SpawnWeight = relative chance (0 or less counts as 1). To change the squad size, change the group prefab.
